DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.student_task_answer') IS NULL AND to_regclass('public.user_task_answer') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE user_task_answer RENAME TO student_task_answer;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.student_task_answer_auto_review') IS NULL AND to_regclass('public.user_task_answer_auto_review') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE user_task_answer_auto_review RENAME TO student_task_answer_auto_review;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.student_task_answer_review') IS NULL AND to_regclass('public.user_task_answer_review') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE user_task_answer_review RENAME TO student_task_answer_review;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_task_answer'
          AND column_name = 'user_id'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_task_answer RENAME COLUMN user_id TO student_id;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_task_answer_auto_review'
          AND column_name = 'user_task_answer_id'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_task_answer_auto_review RENAME COLUMN user_task_answer_id TO student_task_answer_id;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_task_answer_review'
          AND column_name = 'user_task_answer_id'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_task_answer_review RENAME COLUMN user_task_answer_id TO student_task_answer_id;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task_test_answer_variant'
          AND column_name = 'user_task_answer_id'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE task_test_answer_variant RENAME COLUMN user_task_answer_id TO student_task_answer_id;
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer_task_student_idx
    ON student_task_answer(task_id, student_id);

-- Migration 007 replaces this legacy one-row-per-question constraint with
-- structured selection indexes. Do not restore it when migrations are
-- replayed against an already upgraded database.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task_test_answer_variant'
          AND column_name = 'submitted_order'
    ) THEN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_unique_idx
            ON task_test_answer_variant(student_task_answer_id, task_test_id);
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_position (
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    position_id int NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (student_id, position_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_position_student
    ON student_position(student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_pet_project (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    pet_project_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    started_at timestamptz NULL,
    completed_at timestamptz NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    workspace_task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    workspace_lesson_id uuid NOT NULL,
    active_sandbox_id uuid NULL,
    current_task_answer_id uuid NULL,
    preview_url text NULL,
    workspace_state_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    UNIQUE (student_id, pet_project_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_pet_project_workspace_task
    ON student_pet_project(workspace_task_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_pet_project_workspace_lesson
    ON student_pet_project(workspace_lesson_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_pet_project_student
    ON student_pet_project(student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_pet_project_milestone (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_pet_project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_pet_project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    pet_project_part_milestone_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    attempts_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    best_result_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    passed_at timestamptz NULL,
    sandbox_id uuid NULL,
    task_answer_id uuid NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (student_pet_project_id, pet_project_part_milestone_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_pet_project_milestone_project
    ON student_pet_project_milestone(student_pet_project_id, status, updated_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_pet_project_artifact (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_pet_project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_pet_project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    artifact_type varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    storage_file_id uuid NOT NULL,
    preview_url text NULL,
    meta_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_pet_project_task_binding (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_pet_project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_pet_project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_pet_project_milestone_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_pet_project_milestone(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_snapshot_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_pet_project_task_binding_project
    ON student_pet_project_task_binding(student_pet_project_id, created_at DESC);
